QuestInfo.name: A Ward for the Door
QuestInfo.0: #b#p717##k is afraid of what the rot is doing to her house.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p717##k is afraid her light is too weak to hold back the rot, and the #r#o700003##k near #b#m10006121##k keeps coming closer. #b#p702##k in #b#m010006000##k makes glowspore wards. I should bring him #b30 #t4000058#s#k from the #r#o61#s#k so he can make one.
QuestInfo.2: I brought #p702# the materials. He started on a glowspore ward for #p717#'s door.

0.0: Something deep under the grave feeds this rot, and my light alone won't hold it. Look... it's already turning a strange color.
0.1: #b#p702##k in #b#m010006000##k makes glowspore wards. A ward on my door could keep the rot out while I rest my light.
0.2: He'll need materials. Could you bring him #b30 #t4000058#s#k?

yes.0: Thank you! Tell him the light in the old house sent you.

no.0: I understand... I'll keep my light low a little longer.

1.0: #b#p717##k sent you? That little light in the old house? Hm. Her light turning purple is not a good sign.
1.1: These will do. Give me a moment... a ward like this has to be made right.

npc.0: Have you been to #b#p702##k yet? He's in #b#m010006000##k. He'll need #b30 #t4000058#s#k for the ward.

item.0: I need #b30 #t4000058#s#k to make the ward.
